prep_meta.notes: Root cause of failure: raw.ce_irr already contains columns CEDRRYN and CETOXGR; renaming CEDRRYN_STD→CEDRRYN and CETOXGR_STD→CETOXGR in the same step caused a DataFrame column collision triggering the dtype error. Fix: first rename the originals to CEDRRYN_ORIG/CETOXGR_ORIG, then rename the _STD versions to the clean SDTM names in a second rename step. CETERM is uppercased per the mapping rule (strip+upcase). CEPRESP and CEOCCUR are set to Y when CETERM_STD is non-missing (pre-printed symptom selected). CELNKID comes from CEAERECID. EPOCH is derived post-build from SE. CESTDTC/CEENDTC come from the _RAW date columns which are already ISO 8601 format per the sample data.
